title: Full-Stack Digital Marketing Firm Xingbang Raises Multi-¥10M Series B from Jiecheng
summary: On May 11, 2022, full-stack digital marketing firm Xingbang (星榜) (founded Apr 2016) closed a multi-¥10M Series B solely from Jiecheng Capital (Unique Capital FA) — 4th round (angel’16, Pre-A’19, A’20; LPs Kaiming, Meitu, Kuanggu, Qingsong) — for short-video IMC depth + Douyin
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · May 12, 2022

On May 11, 2022, full-stack digital marketing firm Xingbang (星榜) (founded Apr 2016) closed a multi-¥10M Series B solely from Jiecheng Capital (Unique Capital FA) — 4th round (angel’16, Pre-A’19, A’20; LPs Kaiming, Meitu, Kuanggu, Qingsong) — for short-video IMC depth + Douyin ecom/MCN synergy. First-batch Douyin Xingtu / Kuaishou Kuaijiedan core agent; short-video data platform ’19; DP live ecom ’20; Xingbang Mutual Entertainment MCN ’21.

— END —
